subject: Console + API onboarding: staggered attendance and backup hosts
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@techsolv.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Console + API onboarding — request to split attendees

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for walking us through the initial evaluation last week. We want to book the hands-on onboarding (console walkthrough + API enablement) for two small groups at TechSolv: Product Engineers and Platform/Infra. We have limited overlap in availability, so would prefer a split attendance approach rather than one long session.

High-level asks:
- Two 90-minute blocks on the same day, back-to-back if possible (Product first, Platform second)
- A single runbook and shared Zoom so our exec/PM can drop in between blocks
- A backup trainer in case of last-minute conflicts (we had an internal conflict last vendor session)
- Short preflight items we can complete beforehand (keys, sandbox access)

Attendees (tentative):
- Elena Rossi (PM)
- Marco Giannini (Lead Platform Eng)
- 4 Product Engineers (names to follow)
- 2 Platform Engineers

Can you propose two start times next week? Our preference is the morning PT windows but we can adjust. Also, can you send the checklist we should complete before the session so we can get infra access sorted?

Best,
Elena
--
Elena Rossi
Head of Platform, TechSolv Inc.
elena@techsolv.io | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena@techsolv.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Console + API onboarding — request to split attendees

Hi Elena — great to hear you're ready to kick this off. Staggered blocks are a good approach and we can operate from a single Zoom/recording. Proposed plan: 

Option A (preferred):
- Block 1 (Product): 09:30 - 11:00 PT
- 15 minute buffer / quick Q&A handoff
- Block 2 (Platform): 11:15 - 12:45 PT

Option B (if teams need more morning time):
- Block 1: 08:30 - 10:00 PT
- Block 2: 10:15 - 11:45 PT

Coverage/backup: Ben Carter can cover the Platform block if I get stuck in another meeting; Monica Patel can run the Product block if Ben is tied up (cc'd).

Preflight checklist: attaching a short checklist and the env access steps (PDF/md) — can you confirm your engineers can complete the sandbox key step at least 48 hours before the session? If any of them need dedicated service-account provisioning let us know and we can pre-provision.

Logistics question: do you want us to include a short 10-minute ramp for your PM to get up to speed between blocks? We can keep the first 10 minutes of the second block as a recap.

If one of those options works, I'll send calendar invites and the Zoom link.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-onboarding-checklist.pdf, env-access-steps.md

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@techsolv.io>, Marco Giannini <marco@techsolv.io>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Console + API onboarding — request to split attendees

Ben / Monica — forwarding Elena's ask. I'm going to tentatively book Option A on our calendars and invite TechSolv. Ben, please be prepared to lead the Platform block (11:15–12:45 PT). Monica, you'll be backup for the Product block (09:30–11:00 PT).

Runbook notes for you both (quick bullets):
- Preflight: ensure sandbox keys are uploaded and the 2 test requests from env-access-steps.md succeed (curl examples).
- Demo flow: 20 mins console tour (routing/policies), 40 mins hands-on API lab (auth, request patterns, KV caching demo), 15 mins Q&A.
- Fallback policy: if our primary trainer hits >2 consecutive meetings, switch to Ben as primary and Monica as backup; notify Elena and Marco via chat + email.

I'll create the invites after Elena confirms — for now, hold the slots.

Thanks — Option A works for us, please go ahead and send invites. Confirmed attendees: Marco Giannini (Platform lead), myself, and 4 Product Engineers (names attached in the spreadsheet I'll drop into the calendar invite). We'll aim to complete the env-access steps by Friday (48 hours before).

Two small requests before you send invites: 
1) Please include a 10-minute recap at the top of Block 2 for any execs who join late.
2) Can you enable recording and share it after the session?

Once you confirm, I'll accept the invites.

Elena
